claim_text: Our Chilean operations are on track to achieve 100 per cent renewable electricity use in CY2025, as they have each calendar year since CY2022.
context_text: Our Chilean operations are on track to achieve 100 per cent renewable electricity use in CY2025, as they have each calendar year since CY2022.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告在该处只给出“on track”判断，没有提供CY2025已实现的实际百分比或对应历史绩效表，属于仅有定性表述的明显漂绿嫌疑。
notes: claim 自带结果性判断，但未提供同页或相邻页实际绩效数据。
llm_reason: The central assertion is that the company’s Chilean operations have used 100% renewable electricity in each calendar year since CY2022 and are on track to achieve 100% renewable electricity use in CY2025. No substantive evidence is provided beyond the claim text itself—there are no disclosed electricity consumption figures, renewable electricity percentages for CY2022–CY2024, documentation of renewable sourcing instruments, or any progress/forecast data supporting being “on track” for CY2025. Because the decisive 100% achievement across multiple years and the CY2025 trajectory are not verified by any factual evidence in the provided fields, the claim is not substantiated.
